_doc: Vendor price table for statusline.js. Rates are per 1M tokens in the vendor's billing currency.
currency: USD renders as $, CNY as ¥; symbol is the fallback when currency is absent.
match: substrings tested against ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (lower-cased). No match / no ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = Anthropic.
models: key = model slug (lower-case, without [1m]); exact match first, then longest prefix match.
cacheWrite = price charged for tokens written to cache (vendors without a write surcharge: same as input).
peak: optional. Rates in `models` are OFF-PEAK; a request whose timestamp falls in a window on a listed weekday
(UTC day numbers, 0=Sun) is multiplied by `multiplier`. Chinese public holidays are not modelled.
subscription: if set, no cost is computed; the label is shown instead.
cache_ttl_minutes: how long this vendor keeps a prompt-cache prefix alive after the last request. The status line
shows `cache NN% @HH:MM` from the last request + this value; null = unknown, no expiry shown.
Anthropic sessions ignore this and use the TTL Claude Code reports (1h subscription, 5m API key).
A model row may carry its own cache_ttl_minutes, which overrides the vendor value for that model.
While neither is set, the script uses a bidirectional observed estimate for that vendor+model
(~/.claude/cache/statusline-cache-observed.json, written automatically): a cache hit at gap h raises
the lower bound; a miss after a shorter gap m lowers the upper bound to m. A gap counts only between
two consecutive requests to the same model; the shown time is marked with ~.
Edit this file when a vendor changes prices; statusline.js needs no change.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
deepseek.cache_note: DeepSeek caches automatically and evicts unused prefixes after hours; no fixed TTL published. Set a number here to show an expiry.

zhipu-cn.label: GLM
zhipu-cn.cache_note: Zhipu cache storage is limited-time free; TTL not published. Set a number here to show an expiry.
